heap table/index identity, bytes, page/free/overflow/reuse summaries, compress estimates, raw-store sanity, SQL/index reads and read-only reopen behavior remain active in one consolidated heap diagnostics authority
heap RawStore boundary diagnostics remain read-only, preserve Derby page/log compatibility, prohibit format/catalog mutation, and remain stable across reopen; transitional phase naming is retired
centralized raw-page record/page and restore-slot debug assertion messages remain stable without changing operation serialization or normal runtime behavior
inherited heap/btree diagnostic summary formatting and tiny-ratio NA behavior remain explicitly protected by one unit authority

heap provider/container identity, read-only page/file observation and clean consistency snapshot are retained in the provider-neutral mixed inspection authority

heap table/index byte and page statistics, observed-byte identity, compress estimates, compatibility observation, SQL/index reads and read-only reopen behavior remain active in the consolidated heap diagnostics authority

large VARCHAR round-trip/vacuum/reopen remains active without assuming physical overflow; large BLOB/CLOB lifecycle is the current RawStore overflow-page authority; retired attribute-descriptor counters are no longer diagnostics authority

16-19 KB VARCHAR values are not guaranteed to overflow current RawStore page sizing; large VARCHAR lifecycle remains covered separately, while 40-54 KB BLOB/CLOB values explicitly prove real overflow growth, vacuum reclamation and reopen stability
insert/update/delete commit, rollback, own visibility, shutdown and reopen outcomes remain active at the authoritative RawStore SQL boundary

update/delete history growth, indexed visibility, vacuum reclamation and reopen remain active through direct RawStore metadata; legacy physical-version/vacuum counters now intentionally return compatibility zeros

ordered-index authority and fail-closed retained-state behavior replace candidate-index quarantine diagnostics
index-key movement/delete and historical-snapshot visibility remain active in the RawStore ordered-index suite; candidate-index refresh counters were transitional implementation diagnostics

complex primary/unique/secondary-index mutation, savepoint rollback, consistency checks, vacuum and reopen remain active in the differential SQL harness plus authoritative RawStore ordered-index/vacuum suites; direct consistency-counter repetition was redundant

durable SQL state, bounded RawStore maintenance and vacuum/reopen outcomes remain active; the external free-space-map sidecar plus lookup/hit/rebuild counters were retired when RawStore became the sole page-allocation authority

heap/MVCC parity for primary/unique/secondary indexes, prepared DML, NULL/DECIMAL values, large payloads, savepoint rollback, committed update/delete/reinsert, maintenance, consistency and reopen is covered more broadly by the active differential SQL harness

non-key UPDATEs leave indexed key candidates unchanged while current and retained-snapshot reads remain correct; old hot-index/candidate counters are superseded by direct RawStore ordered-index entry/version assertions
RawStore is sole MVCC write authority and writer-conflict/rollback behavior is covered without inherited write-front instrumentation
retired inherited write-front cannot become authority; quarantine/shadow diagnostics are no longer product semantics
removed inherited write-front is superseded by sole RawStore runtime authority and fail-closed retired-format proof

primary/unique duplicate rejection, rollback/delete key reuse, concurrent unique arbitration, secondary-index update/delete/savepoint behavior and reopen remain active in RawStore unique/index authority
READ COMMITTED refresh, REPEATABLE READ stability and own-write visibility remain active across both providers; page-backed/legacy-fallback counters were transitional path diagnostics
historical reads use RawStore version chains and retained legacy snapshot state fails closed

version churn preserves stable logical row identity, index key movement/delete remains correct, and purged row/version identities are never reused; candidate-index row-id counters were transitional diagnostics
legacy snapshot fallback closeout is covered by retained-state rejection and RawStore historical-snapshot behavior
enduring equality/range/projection index authority is covered by the active RawStore ordered-index suite

equality lookup, historical-snapshot fail-closed behavior and pre-index compatibility/rebuild remain active; missing/malformed external ordered-index sidecar and legacy lookup counters were retired with RawStore convergence
ordered-index skeleton/rebuild milestone is superseded by active file/reopen/lazy-rebuild/memory coverage
range ordering, oversized-key fallback and historical/current visibility remain active in RawStore ordered-index authority; legacy lookup/row-id counters were transitional
page-backed authority milestone is superseded by the RawStore authority and end-to-end durable vertical slice
base/current/historical reads are proven through RawStore without page-backed diagnostic counters
index rebuild/reopen semantics remain active through native RawStore index compatibility and crash proofs
only committed changed rows survive; rollback/savepoint and crash outcomes are covered by active RawStore mutation tests
commit/rollback/savepoint isolation is covered at the authoritative RawStore transaction boundary
real committed mutations and no-op suppression are covered without intermediate page-backed version counters
current committed and historical visibility are covered by active RawStore tests
transaction-local scans and stable snapshots are covered at RawStore level
surviving insert/update/delete intent semantics are covered through authoritative transaction outcomes; payload-summary diagnostics were transitional
write-intent commit/rollback/savepoint semantics are covered by active RawStore transaction tests

file/reopen and crash-recovery durability remain active through RawStore; the Delos-specific page-cache generation/pin/eviction counters were retired because buffering is now inherited RawStore responsibility

eligible history reclamation, snapshot-safe vacuum, relinking and survivor persistence remain active; page-local-prune/FSM/visibility-map counters described the retired external page-backed implementation

mutation and vacuum commit/rollback/savepoint outcomes remain active at the RawStore transaction boundary; page-mutation-context reservation/write/FSM/reusable-index counters were transition-only instrumentation

vacuumed-row removal, stable identity non-reuse, subsequent inserts and reopen durability remain active; the external reusable-page allocation-index file, physical-version diagnostics and exact page-capacity reuse policy were retired with the page-backed runtime and are not current Delos semantic contracts
provider-first append/shadow-write-front milestone is obsolete after RawStore became sole authority
authoritative mutation/index outcomes replace provider-append and candidate-rebuild diagnostic gates

default-off policy, commit wakeups, one bounded worker, retained-snapshot horizon, database isolation and memory-database maintenance are all active in the database-scoped RawStore maintenance authority; old per-table purge-daemon counters were superseded

autonomous history reclamation and deleted-row purge remain active; the external purge-queue sidecar and enqueue/drain entry counters were retired in favor of database-scoped RawStore maintenance snapshots
current-row physical routing and stale/missing locator fallback remain active through RawStore row-location hints; provider-wide rowIdFastPath counters were retired
insert/update/delete savepoint rollback, unique-key reuse and heap/MVCC savepoint semantics remain active in enduring RawStore transaction suites

MVCC provider/container identity, RawStore-owned page observation and clean consistency remain active; legacy logical-row counters plus page-volume/checkpoint state files belonged to the retired external persistence runtime and are now explicitly rejected

typed INT/BIGINT/DECIMAL ranges, NULL indexed values and text resembling legacy typed envelopes remain explicitly active without retired ordered-index/row-id counters; broader typed indexed parity remains covered by deterministic differential fuzzing

update/delete history pruning, repeatable-read snapshot protection, final visible rows, reopen and transactional vacuum outcomes are covered more strongly by RawStore metadata inspection; legacy physical/logical-version diagnostic counters now intentionally report compatibility zeros

visibility-horizon protection, reclaimable history and post-vacuum state remain active through RawStore version metadata and maintenance snapshots; the external visibility/prune-map sidecar, tombstone/prunable/all-visible and rebuild counters were retired

uncommitted insert/update/delete invisibility, write/write conflict outcomes, READ COMMITTED refresh, REPEATABLE READ snapshot stability and reopen durability remain active in differential isolation plus RawStore locking/version-chain authority
same-transaction own-write visibility and rollback/commit behavior remain active; write-intent overlay counters were transitional
testing-helper consumption checkpoint is superseded by the real compiler production hook proving planning-only versus two-property consumption and preserved Derby remainder evaluation
execution counter was testing-only checkpoint scaffolding with no production recorder; enduring current-committed ordered access and snapshot fail-closed semantics remain active
planning opt-in/default-off behavior is now exercised through the actual compiler hook and one enduring fail-closed metadata safety test
heap/MVCC capability flags, provider normalization, read-only reporting and optimizer neutrality remain active in the consolidated provider-neutral metadata authority

report-only cost default-off/explicit-enable/fail-closed semantics and saturation remain active; real Derby optimizer consumption stays separately owned by the production opt-in test; retired MVCC logical-row reporting is not preserved
explicit diagnostics context does not mutate provider state; metadata contexts remain read-only, optimizer-neutral and execution-routing-neutral with invalid contexts rejected

deterministic heap/MVCC provider ordering, normalized metadata snapshots, statistics/cost report chaining, optimizer neutrality and SQL read-only outcomes remain active; RawStore-owned MVCC keeps page metrics but no retired logical-row or external storage-file-byte counters
pre-optimizer readiness report was a milestone gate; its enduring pushdown safety and explicit optimizer-cost opt-in outcomes now have active production authorities
heap/current-MVCC/snapshot predicate split and Derby remainder preservation are consolidated into the active production-hook authority

heap/MVCC provider-normalized read-only statistics and SQL read-only outcomes remain active; heap retains storage-file-byte observation while RawStore-owned MVCC retains page metrics and explicitly reports no retired logical-row or external storage-file-byte counters
